# Administrative Change

This folder tracks administrative adjustments and structural shifts in how healthcare databases report their annual findings. It specifically documents changes to publication formats, such as the decision to omit standard demographic overviews—including age and gender distributions—from the 2025 annual report of the Akut Kirurgi Databasen. These entries highlight evolving data governance and presentation priorities within clinical registries.

## Pages

- [[administrative-change|Administrative Change]] — Documents specific adjustments to healthcare database reporting metrics, such as the removal of age and gender distribution overviews in the 2025 Akut Kirurgi Databasen annual report.
